# jaff.core.reaction.config

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Config of the reactions (`[network.reactions]`).

`[network.reactions]` holds the settings applied to every reaction, and
`[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]` overrides them for one
reaction (see `resolve`).  String choices are
case-insensitive and stored lower-cased.

## Classes

| Class | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`PhotoConfig`](photoconfig/index.md) | Photo-reaction settings (`[network.reactions.photo]`). |
| [`ReactionConfig`](reactionconfig/index.md) | Settings of one reaction (`[network.reactions.reaction."<serialized>"]`). |
| [`ReactionsConfig`](reactionsconfig/index.md) | Settings of the reactions (`[network.reactions]`). |
